findings.highlight: entertains the idea that she's some servant of evil
findings.evidenceJa: 毒婦だなんだと喜んでおる
findings.governingReading: Issei reports that his brother delights in calling the guest a wicked woman, before giving his own favorable impression.
findings.explanation: Issei's brother's enjoyment of calling Caster wicked becomes consideration of an evil identity, making his reported response more speculative and less amused.

findings.highlight: she is a fair person, though she seems a little foul.
findings.evidenceJa: 悪ぶっているように見えるが根は善人だ
findings.governingReading: 悪ぶっているように見える means apparently putting on a bad/wicked pose, contrasted with 根は善人, goodness at the root.
findings.explanation: An apparent pose of wickedness over underlying goodness becomes a fair person who seems foul.

findings.highlight: What I admire was that she doesn't look at herself.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が感心したのは、あの女が自分でも気付いていない部分の話
findings.governingReading: あの女が自分でも気付いていない部分 is a part/aspect of the woman that even she has not noticed; that aspect is what Issei admires.
findings.explanation: Admiring an unrecognized part of her character becomes admiring her failure to look at herself.
